summary: Authority audit complete: current primitives cannot establish complete production occupancy or provider-terminal provenance; production capacity remains HOLD. No source change is justified within this lease. Exact producer design and bounded source reproduction recorded in evidence.
nextAction: Lead: determine/enforce participating-sender and legacy/offline boundary and assign disjoint host/inventory, manual (W23), schedule (W19), and native ingress/host leases; establish authenticated baseline and provider terminal issuer before enabling admission. Track existing inventory authority challenge 5f8cfc67dfb24993aad94c15870b96dc; independently review every new source increment.
evidence:
Pinned remote main 3f84149a29950830d5bb217fa341611d95bfe958 via git ls-remote. Inspected W14 checkpoint 14518, W23 14488, W21 accepted abef95dc790ce6f95c51968e8cfb37203c431887 and W16 accepted fixture 686971c8784c41ee80181eb9da3438a072cd7d52. Bounded static reproduction at pinned main: git grep -n -E 'ProjectCapacityAdmission|planReservation' 3f84149a29950830d5bb217fa341611d95bfe958 -- Client returns only the module declaration, planner and internal fixture reserve call. Client/SignalR/Client.fs:711-734 records target, assignment snapshot and digest but not capacity or a provider identity; :915-932 target=None skips attribution then directly sends. Client/Program.fs:229-269 schedule sets TargetAgentId=None and calls BrowserBridge directly. Thus two possible histories (no active sessions versus an unattributed scheduled launch already running) have identical attributed-launch records; a producer reading those records cannot distinguish zero from nonzero occupancy. This is a source-level counterexample, not an executed live launch. BrowserOpenTab and arbitrary/legacy/offline clients are further uncovered. W21 read rejects absent state and initializer/transition are compile-time disposable-only. W16 fixture README expressly assumes an empty isolated repo and lacks authenticated fencing and terminal evidence. Accepted native Stage C b735b2f2f990dc9dd8903a93aebc3202edb10d06 Client/AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress.fs:222-285 binds account/project/head/intent in CAS to HeldBeforeSend; Client/AutomationNativeProviderSessionHost.fs:315-322 explicitly denies dispatch and terminal release because no authenticated provider issuer exists. These are not proof of actual complete inventory.
Proposed smallest real design after Lead-defined boundary: inventory owner adds a production project-ledger adapter with epoch-bound baseline established only by authenticated exhaustive quiescence/coverage (unknown remains closed), persisted immutable original launch ID, role/version, generation, policy revision and account/project binding; in LedgerStore.transact re-read same snapshot, validate coverage, role, policy and capacity, and atomically reserve plus original intent. Sender owners W23 and W19 invoke a shared exact-generation one-shot Held->Dispatching CAS immediately before their first effect, with immutable source/arguments and no replay authority. Native host owner composes this same project transition with the existing claimCore evidence; no separate signing system. Concurrent manual/scheduled/native contenders retry CAS and recompute all predicates; stale policy/epoch/generation, missing sender coverage, failed auth, unknown baseline and mismatched original deny. Once dispatch may have occurred, retain occupied across timeout, restart and crash; only immutable, authenticated provider terminal bound to the exact original effect/session/generation or a durable same-fence pre-send exclusion can release. Browser ACK/tab closure/agent inactivity cannot issue terminal proof; cancellation after Dispatching cannot imply no-send. Persist transitions and reconcile unknown effects without replay. Tests must exercise concurrent senders, CAS retry, stale generations, baseline absence, offline/old clients, send/no-send race, crash at each boundary and false/mismatched terminal. A live trustworthy baseline/terminal source and enforcement of noncooperative clients are dependencies, not available inputs. No test, source mutation, live send or deployment performed in this audit.
